description.narrative:
Project-Level Outcome: 1) Improved access to finance for un(der)served MSMEs: IFC anticipates that, through the support to MBank, which is backed by a strong sponsor and an existing IFC client, the Project will enable MBank to expand lending to MSMEs, including women-led/owned MSMEs.
Market-Level Outcome: 1) Inclusiveness: With financial institutions in Mongolia being concentrated mainly in the urban areas, IFC anticipates the Project will promote the use of an innovative digital channel to improve user experiences and financial inclusion for MSMEs more efficiently in the country. 2) Competitiveness: IFC anticipates the Project to use the digital platform and user-friendly digitalization, including potential data-based credit underwriting, to bring the catalytic effect to the competitiveness in the banking industry.

The proposed investment consists of a 3-year US$30 million syndicated senior loan facility to MBank Closed JSC (MBank, or the Bank), comprised of (i) an up to US$16 million A Loan, (ii) an up to US$8 million syndicated loan, and iii) a Trust Loan of up to US$6 million from IFC acting in its capacity as implementing entity for the Managed Co-Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP). The US$30 million facility will be committed in two tranches on a pro-rata basis between A Loan and syndicated loans. The Project aims to support the Banks MSMEs portfolio, with at least 25% of the loan proceeds expected to support women-owned SMEs.
